key_features_and_views.title: Stream Monitoring & Mission Control
key_features_and_views.description: Real-time stream health matrix, total egress/ingest bandwidth gauge, viewer sessions map, and instant video preview wall.

key_features_and_views.title: Ingest & Input Sources Management
key_features_and_views.description: Configure SRT (Listener/Caller), RTMP, RTSP, HLS pull, WebRTC, NDI, and RIST feeds with stream keys, failover rules, and buffer latencies.

key_features_and_views.title: Transcoding Profiles & Hardware Encoding
key_features_and_views.description: Manage multi-bitrate ladder generation, codec targets (H.264, H.265/HEVC, AV1, VP9), audio codecs (AAC, Opus), and GPU acceleration (NVENC, QSV).

key_features_and_views.title: Playlists & VOD Archive
key_features_and_views.description: Schedule continuous live playout loops, manage DVR recording storage retention, transmux VOD to HLS/DASH, and asset metadata.

key_features_and_views.title: Analytics & Cluster Diagnostics
key_features_and_views.description: Interactive bandwidth and latency graphs, peak concurrent viewers (CCU), error heatmaps, frame drop metrics, and node CPU/GPU health.

key_features_and_views.title: Access Control & DRM Security
key_features_and_views.description: API keys, publishing tokens, geo-blocking, DRM encryption (AES-128, Widevine, FairPlay), and role-based user permissions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-tab or route-based dashboard interface for Stream Anywhere.
Ensure data-testid attributes are included on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions, filters).
Use high-density technical layouts with monospaced readouts for bitrates (e.g., '6.4 Mbps'), resolution ('1080p60'), codecs ('HEVC / AAC'), and keyframe intervals ('2.0s').
Integrate live interactive chart visualizations using Recharts or Lucide icons for stream metrics.
Include live preview modals/players with simulated HTML5 video / canvas stream displays and audio level meters.
Provide state controls to start/stop streams, trigger failover, modify transcoding profiles, and add new input sources.
Support dark theme by default with clean contrast for operational clarity.
